steps.title: Your profile
steps.description: Tell us who we're creating this EPK for. Use the name and professional title you want organizers to see.

steps.title: Your story
steps.description: Write naturally. You don't have to produce a polished biography—we'll use your answers to draft one for approval.

steps.title: Your ministry
steps.description: Help churches and organizers understand your ministry focus and the invitations you accept.

steps.title: Your music
steps.eyebrow: For musicians, DJs and worship teams
steps.description: Share your sound, your work and the performances you'd like people to discover.

steps.title: Bookings & invitations
steps.eyebrow: Make it easy to reach you
steps.description: Set out your preferred booking process. Private commercial details are kept separate from public information.

steps.title: Media & branding
steps.description: Share your best images, videos and links. A cloud folder works best for large media files.

steps.title: Review & permissions
steps.description: Confirm which information may be published. We'll still send you the EPK draft for approval before it goes live.

fields.name: profile_type
fields.label: EPK profile type
options: Singers, DJs, bands, choirs and worship artists

fields.name: public_name
fields.label: Public name / stage name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Pastor Nomsa Mokoena

fields.name: title_role
fields.label: Title / role
fields.placeholder: e.g. Evangelist, Worship Leader

fields.name: city_province_country
fields.label: City, province & country
fields.placeholder: e.g. Gqeberha, Eastern Cape, South Africa

fields.name: ministry_organisation_group
fields.label: Ministry / organisation / group
fields.placeholder: Name, if applicable

fields.name: preferred_languages
fields.label: Preferred languages
fields.placeholder: e.g. English, isiXhosa, isiZulu

fields.name: primary_contact_person
fields.label: Primary contact person
fields.placeholder: Person coordinating this EPK

fields.name: private_contact
fields.label: Private contact email / phone
fields.placeholder: For our team only

fields.name: one_sentence_intro
fields.label: One-sentence introduction
fields.placeholder: I am / We are ... and we help or inspire people through ...

fields.name: journey_beginning
fields.label: How did your journey begin?
fields.placeholder: Tell us about your beginnings, early influences, important turning points and what led you here.

fields.name: mission_message
fields.label: Your mission or central message
fields.placeholder: What do you want people to understand, experience or remember?

fields.name: milestones_achievements
fields.label: Important milestones or achievements
fields.placeholder: Years in ministry, notable events, recordings, awards, outreach, training ...

fields.name: distinctiveness
fields.label: What makes your ministry / artistry distinctive?
fields.placeholder: Your voice, approach, audience, values or recurring themes ...

fields.name: ministry_focus_themes
fields.label: Ministry focus and key preaching themes
fields.placeholder: Evangelism, discipleship, teaching, revival, leadership, youth, family ...

fields.name: invitation_types
fields.label: Types of invitations you accept
fields.placeholder: Sunday services, conferences, crusades, seminars, workshops, camps ...

fields.name: past_host_churches
fields.label: Past host churches, events or highlights
fields.placeholder: Name and location; specify what we may mention publicly.

fields.name: statement_of_faith
fields.label: Statement of faith or ministry approach
fields.placeholder: Optional—only what you approve for publication.

fields.name: sermon_links
fields.label: Links to sermons, talks or ministry footage
fields.placeholder: Paste one link per line.

fields.name: genres_musical_style
fields.label: Genres / musical style
fields.placeholder: e.g. Gospel, Amapiano, Afro House

fields.name: performance_format
fields.label: Performance format
fields.placeholder: Solo, full band, DJ set, worship team ...

fields.name: key_songs_releases
fields.label: Key songs, projects and releases
fields.placeholder: Titles, years and links to featured releases ...

fields.name: streaming_links
fields.label: Streaming, music and performance links
fields.placeholder: Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, Audiomack ...

fields.name: performance_highlights
fields.label: Notable performances, collaborations, awards or coverage
fields.placeholder: Event names, years, artists and media coverage ...

fields.name: live_video_links
fields.label: Performance sample / live video links
fields.placeholder: Your best live footage, one link per line.

fields.name: public_booking_email
fields.label: Public booking email
fields.placeholder: bookings@example.com

fields.name: booking_contact_manager
fields.label: Booking contact person / manager
fields.placeholder: Name and role, if applicable

fields.name: booking_process
fields.label: Preferred invitation or booking process
fields.placeholder: Should people send a WhatsApp, email, booking form or contact your manager first? Any notice period?

fields.name: event_requirements
fields.label: Practical event requirements
fields.placeholder: Travel, accommodation, sound, setup, performance duration or hospitality ...
fields.hint: Do not include sensitive personal or financial details.

fields.name: private_commercial_arrangements
fields.label: Commercial arrangements — PRIVATE
fields.placeholder: Honorarium, fees or travel contribution expectations (optional)
fields.hint: For internal planning only. Never published without separate approval.

fields.name: media_folder_link
fields.label: Shared media folder link
fields.placeholder: https://drive.google.com/...
fields.hint: An accessible Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox folder. For media not ready, enter 'Will provide later'.

fields.name: media_inventory
fields.label: Media inventory
fields.placeholder: Headshots, performance photos, logos, videos, artwork ...

fields.name: social_media_links
fields.label: Official social media / website links
fields.placeholder:
Instagram — https://...
Facebook — https://...
Website — https://...

fields.name: testimonials_quotes
fields.label: Testimonials, endorsements or press quotes
fields.placeholder: Quote, name and role of the person; confirm you have permission to share.

fields.name: preferred_colours_style
fields.label: Preferred colours / style
fields.placeholder: e.g. warm neutrals, modern and elegant

fields.name: domain_preference
fields.label: Website / domain preference
fields.placeholder: An existing domain or a preferred address

fields.name: primary_cta_examples
fields.label: Primary call to action and example EPKs
fields.placeholder: What should visitors do first? Any EPK examples you like?

fields.name: public_contact_details
fields.label: What contact details may be shown publicly?
fields.placeholder: List exactly which email, WhatsApp number, city and links can appear, or enter 'None'.

fields.name: media_rights_confirmation
fields.label: Media and quotation rights confirmation
options: I own or have permission to use all material supplied
Some permissions are still pending—please confirm with me before using them
fields.hint: Material with pending permissions will not be published.

fields.name: final_review_restrictions
fields.label: Final content review contact and publication restrictions
fields.placeholder: Who approves the draft? Mention anything that must remain private or needs separate approval.

fields.name: completed_by
fields.label: Completed by / name
fields.placeholder: Your full name
